entities.name: Implicit Maze
entities.description: A system of mana paths or leylines through the guildgates and districts of Ravnica that manifested after the Guildpact was destroyed; great power lies at its end in the Forum of Azor.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane whose ten guilds are bound by the Guildpact and which holds the Implicit Maze.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The pact binding Ravnica's ten guilds; it was destroyed, and Jace was later declared the new Guildpact.

entities.name: Azor I
entities.description: Founder of the Azorius Senate who created the Implicit Maze to be revealed if the Guildpact dissolved.

entities.name: Niv-Mizzet
entities.description: Leader who instructed the discovery of the maze and announced that each guild must send a champion to run it.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker whose notes helped reveal the maze; he entered the race, merged the runners' minds and was declared the new Guildpact.

entities.name: Ral Zarek
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Izzet League who discovered the maze and replaced Melek as its runner; later proposed altering it.

entities.name: Lazav
entities.description: Figure who manipulated the champions into fighting again at the Forum of Azor.

entities.name: Bailiff of the Forum
entities.description: Guardian of the Forum of Azor who delivered the Supreme Verdict and declared Jace the new Guildpact.

entities.name: Supreme Verdict
entities.description: Azor's failsafe that would eliminate the guilds entirely if they did not seek harmony.

entities.name: Forum of Azor
entities.description: Site at the Maze's End where great power lies.

entities.name: Transguild Promenade
entities.description: Place where the champions met to begin the race.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: Ravnican guild founded by Azor I.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: Ravnican guild led by Niv-Mizzet.

entities.name: Lavinia
entities.description: Maze runner for the Azorius Senate.

entities.name: Tajic
entities.description: Maze runner for the Boros Legion.

entities.name: Mirko Vosk
entities.description: Maze runner for House Dimir.

entities.name: Varolz
entities.description: Maze runner for the Golgari Swarm.

entities.name: Ruric Thar
entities.description: Maze runner for the Gruul Clans.

entities.name: Melek
entities.description: Maze runner for the Izzet League, replaced by Ral Zarek.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Maze runner for the Orzhov Syndicate.

entities.name: Exava
entities.description: Maze runner for the Cult of Rakdos.

entities.name: Emmara Tandris
entities.description: Maze runner for the Selesnya Conclave.

entities.name: Vorel
entities.description: Maze runner for the Simic Combine.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Conflict preceded by a failed guild summit.

events.summary: Azor I creates the maze to be revealed if the Guildpact dissolved, so that all guilds must traverse it together.
events.quote: The maze was created by Azor I to be revealed in case the Guildpact dissolved.

events.summary: Ral Zarek discovers the maze on Niv-Mizzet's instruction using Jace Beleren's notes.
events.quote: The pattern connects arcane landmarks of all ten guilds and extends in more than two dimensions.

events.summary: Niv-Mizzet announces each guild must send one champion to run the maze.
events.quote: Niv-Mizzet announced that each guild would have to send one champion as its delegate in the running of the maze.

events.summary: The champions meet at the Transguild Promenade and race through the maze.
events.quote: At an appointed time, the champions met at the Transguild Promenade

events.summary: Lazav manipulates the champions into fighting again after Jace stops them momentarily at the Forum of Azor.
events.quote: He managed to stop them momentarily, but Lazav appeared and manipulated the champions into fighting once more.

events.summary: The bailiff delivers the Supreme Verdict to every runner; Jace connects the ten minds to prevent its casting, unraveling his own mind.
events.quote: Jace connected the ten minds of the runners to prevent any from casting the verdict.

events.summary: The bailiff eases Jace's burden and declares him the new Guildpact.
events.quote: Fortunately, the bailiff assisted him, easing the burden he had put upon himself.

events.summary: After the failed guild summit, Ral Zarek proposes artificial energy lines to alter the maze and let Niv-Mizzet become Living Guildpact without the guilds' consent.
events.quote: After the guild summit failed in the build-up to the War of the Spark
